purpose: Compare provider-normalized observation time windows without inferring causation.

within_tolerance.meaning: Disjoint windows are separated by no more than the configured tolerance.

disjoint.meaning: Observed windows are separated beyond tolerance.

insufficient_time_metadata.meaning: The pair cannot be temporally compared from the available metadata.

source_obstruction.meaning: At least one source is transient or unavailable.

status_semantics.KUUOS_OBSERVABILITY_TEMPORAL_CORRELATION: All pairs have current comparable time metadata.
At least one pair lacks time metadata or contains a provider-local obstruction.
Input, authority, schema, digest, or time-window invariant failed.
